summary_md: **Klaus ([@KlauseSchip](https://x.com/KlauseSchip/status/2116129494603907370))** highlights Herdr's open-sourced **herdr-core**, a headless Apache-2.0 server keeping terminals and coding agents alive after windows close, where agents spawn and message child agents (hc run/send), report status via an escape-code protocol and SSH machines join the list ([herdrdev/herdr-core](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr-core)).
